newsitem.title: USA: ABC leads U.S. TV ratings Oct 28-Nov 3.
newsitem.headline: ABC leads U.S. TV ratings Oct 28-Nov 3.

text.p: Walt Disney Co unit ABC, bolstered by a special showing of "The Lion King," led the pack in attracting evening-hour audiences during the October 28-November 3 week.
ABC drew an average 11.1 rating, capturing an 18 percent share of the television-viewing audience, or 10.76 million viewers, Nielsen Media Research said Tuesday.
Close behind was General Electric Co unit NBC, which also captured an 18 percent share of the market, or 10.34 million viewers, and posting a 10.7 rating.
Placing third for the week, which ended November 3, was Westinghouse Electric Co unit CBS, which had a 16 percent share of the market, or 9.15 million viewers, for a 9.4 rating.
ABC's showing was bolstered by its special showing of "The Lion King," which captured 15.2 rating, or a 23 percent share of the television-viewing households for the week.
News Corp Ltd unit Fox captured a 7.5 rating, or percentage, of America's 97 million homes with televisions, and a 12 percent share of viewing households.
WB, a unit of Time Warner Inc, drew a 2.7 rating, and a 4 percent share of the viewing households.
UPN, a unit of Chris-Chraft Industries allied with Viacom Inc, had a rating of 3.5, and a 5 percent share of the viewing households.
-- Lisa Marie Pane, New York newsdesk, 212 859-1709
